title: ai_compose_apply_by_key overwrites an in-flight ApplyInPlace and sends a second AI request
trigger: Bind a style to the apply shortcut, type text, press the shortcut twice quickly (or once in the main window and once in a chat window) before the first answer arrives
effect: A second ai_apply_in_place request is sent (wasted AI quota, a flood limit can trip) and the first request's stage is dropped, so its answer never lands; in two windows the first window's result is silently lost
fix: Refuse (or ignore) the shortcut while apply_in_place is Some, or make it an enum Idle/Asked{request,..} where a new ask replaces only after cancelling; same-window repeat press is a no-op

title: AiComposeOpen::select_saved is a one-shot Option slot nothing clears if the saved style never shows up
trigger: Save a new style in the editor; the styles refresh never lists the name (renamed server side, refresh fails)
effect: select_saved stays Some until the box closes and re-checks style_names every frame; harmless today because the box owns it
fix: Fold into AiComposeView (Card { select_on_arrival: Option<String> }) or an enum with a way out when the style list answer lands without the name

title: TonWalletState keeps each fetched value beside a separate Fetch<()> stage
trigger: Open the Money page: own/state_fetch, rates/rates_fetch, explorer_url/explorer are written by different reducers
effect: No bug today (answers are matched by RequestId), but value and stage can disagree (own Some while state_fetch Failed after an update)
fix: Fetch<OwnWallet>, Fetch<Vec<(String,f64)>>, Fetch<String> so the value lives in Ready

title: EventLogPage::poll and ::typed are Option<Task> used as started flags; autoload is a one-shot Cell<Option<usize>>
trigger: Open Recent actions; the poll restarts only when page.poll.is_none() (event_log.rs, resume_event_log_poll), autoload is set and cleared by hand
effect: No bug today (page owns the tasks, tests cover wake/restart), but 'is the poll running' is answered by Option::is_none rather than a stage
fix: EventLogPoll::{Stopped, Running { _task }} and autoload folded into an EventLogLoad stage

title: baseline: DebugConfirm::{Closed, Asking{logs_on}} is a two-variant box flag (stage-enums-baseline unkeyed:DebugConfirm::Asking)
trigger: Toggle debug mode in Advanced; the confirm is a local yes/no, no request is out
effect: No bug: Asking holds only the bool being confirmed, closed by close(); listed so the register shows what is left in stage-enums-baseline
fix: Allow-list with the reason (a local confirm, no request) or move the bool into the box's own state
